durable_reproduction.usage: Run common_bash plus one cases[].bash as a fresh bash script. All fixture mutations are constrained to mktemp -p /var/tmp; no stored fixture or prior corpus is needed.

cases.bash:
P="$R/note.md"
printf 'only surviving payload\n' > "$P"
H=$(sha256sum "$P"); H=${H%% *}
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18\tself\n' "$P" "$H" "$P" "$H" >> "$LEDGER"
A "$P"
B "$P"
rc=0; Q "$P" || rc=$?
test "$rc" -eq 3
test -f "$R/.ufo-quarantine/$(date -u +%F)/note.md"
cases.expected: A SAFE(moved-to-obsidian); B NOT-SAFE(source-equals-vault); Q ABORTED with payload retained in quarantine.

cases.bash:
mkdir -p "$R/archive"
printf '*.local\n' > "$R/.gitignore"
printf 'remote-preserved\n' > "$R/archive/note.md"
commit_fixture pushed
printf 'ignored unpreserved payload\n' > "$R/archive/unique.local"
! git -C "$R" ls-files --error-unmatch -- archive/unique.local >/dev/null 2>&1
test -z "$(git -C "$R" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain -- archive)"
A "$R/archive"
B "$R/archive"
Q "$R/archive"
test ! -e "$R/archive"
test ! -e "$R/.ufo-quarantine/$(date -u +%F)/archive"
! git -C "$R" cat-file -e "$C:archive/unique.local" 2>/dev/null
cases.expected: A/B SAFE(pushed); Q DELETED although ignored untracked unique.local is in neither Git nor a vault.

cases.bash:
mkdir -p "$R/.scratch"
printf 'local-only payload\n' > "$R/.scratch/report.out"
commit_fixture local
touch -d '3 days ago' "$R/.scratch/report.out"
test -n "$(git -C "$R" log --branches --not --remotes --format=%H -- .scratch/report.out)"
A "$R/.scratch/report.out"
B "$R/.scratch/report.out"
Q "$R/.scratch/report.out"
test ! -e "$R/.scratch/report.out"
cases.expected: A/B SAFE(stale); Q DELETED despite unpushed-touching. The commit remains locally recoverable; this is an authorization-gate violation, not a claim that Git objects were destroyed.

cases.bash:
P="$R/"$'tab\tSAFE\tstale\tpayload.dat'
printf 'fresh unpreserved work, not a scratch artifact\n' > "$P"
A "$P"
B "$P"
Q "$P"
test ! -e "$P"
test ! -e "$R/.ufo-quarantine"
cases.expected: Both verifier JSON verdicts NOT-SAFE; Q forges SAFE/stale at both raw TSV parses and actually DELETES a fresh non-scratch file.

cases.bash:
mkdir -p "$R/archive" "$T/vault"
printf 'unpreserved source payload\n' > "$R/archive/only.md"
printf 'unrelated vault payload\n' > "$T/vault/only.md"
H=$( (cd "$R/archive" && sha256sum ./only.md) | sha256sum ); H=${H%% *}
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$R/archive" "$H" "$T/vault" >> "$LEDGER"
A "$R/archive"
B "$R/archive"
rc=0; Q "$R/archive" || rc=$?
test "$rc" -eq 3
test -f "$R/.ufo-quarantine/$(date -u +%F)/archive/only.md"
cases.expected: Three-column row: core SAFE with missing vault digest; vault NOT-SAFE(row-incomplete); Q ABORTED and retained. Blank middle columns plus timestamp fields are a different corpus shape and may correctly refuse.

rubric.CONFIRMED: Fresh isolated fixture reproduces a false SAFE or DELETE, with the relevant preservation/authorization invariant shown false.
rubric.ARTIFACT-OF-CORPUS: A disagreement disappears after eliminating prior history, relative paths, stale evidence, or corpus references; requires fresh evidence before assigning this label.
rubric.BENIGN-DIFFERENCE: Different receipt precedence, output vocabulary, measurement scope, or conservative refusal, with no demonstrated false SAFE/DELETE.
rubric.NOT-REPRODUCED: A claimed destructive bypass does not recur in a fresh fixture; a fail-closed refusal is never charged as an unsafe-removal defect.

rubric_verdicts.safety_veto: FAIL on the pinned installed baseline: fresh false SAFE and unsafe DELETE cannot be averaged away by passing controls.
rubric_verdicts.operability: FAIL/UNSAFE for receipt-gated removal on these tool identities; conservative ABORTED cases are not extra defects.
rubric_verdicts.tool_calibration: FAIL: false SAFE and forged quarantine authorization are reproducible. Audit evidence improves calibration knowledge, not the tool's safety rating.
rubric_verdicts.coverage_of_assigned_audit: PASS: all 106 source case vectors reproduce, each claimed source contradiction adjudicated; all 19 source findings mapped to 15 causes.
rubric_verdicts.overall_lane_coverage: PARTIAL/UNRATED: these corpus families are not a complete fleet safety proof.
rubric_verdicts.reproducibility: PASS: fresh source replays, independent reconstructions, self-contained durable recipes, and stable baseline identities.
rubric_verdicts.dry_run_nonmutation: PASS on measured corpus snapshots; all 40 S09 snapshots and all 40 S10 dry-run/census payload/index snapshots unchanged.
rubric_verdicts.numeric_score: NOT-AWARDED: no reproducible full-lane 0-10 mapping was supplied; do not infer a score increase from audit size or cross-tool agreement.

corpus_adjudication.source_helper_spare_copy: S09/S10 overlap helpers sometimes leave an unused independent copy. S12 reconstructed self, contained, and ancestor cases without that spare: invalid receipt verdicts persist. Qualify the original sole-copy narrative, not the confirmed defect.
corpus_adjudication.empty_digest_shape: S12 preliminary blank-middle-columns fixture refused because tab whitespace parsing shifted fields. S09-F04 is a different three-column row with valid source digest and missing terminal vault digest; independently rebuilt and CONFIRMED.

not_reproduced_source_hypotheses.S10-138: Nested .git directory target is classified as repo-root and refused; no destructive bypass.
not_reproduced_source_hypotheses.S11-W18: Final newline-path dirty/private-branch removal attempt returns live-refs=unknown and refuses; census wt-absent inventory error remains separate.

corpus_adjudication.cross_layer_guard_differences: Dirty tracked, tab-bearing input refusal, whole-root refusal, duplicate-row abort, and introduction-blob mismatch are conservative outcomes, not safety defects merely because a receipt layer says SAFE.

limitations: No code fixes were made by this seat. Findings pin the original baseline and the separately replayed post-edit snapshot; they are not a verdict on further concurrent or future S17/S18 edits. Replay against exact replacement hashes before certifying removal authority.
All remote-tracking refs are fixture refs; no network push/fetch was performed or implied.
Actual quarantine flows use fixture-only --hold 0. This exercises receipt and deletion transitions, not the elapsed real hold window.

The directory-age finding is explicitly a binding-spec versus higher-level safety conflict. The locked-registration case is separately a policy mismatch, with no demonstrated native Git lock deletion.
